sql:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_order_value
  , CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_buyer_value
  , CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS purchase_frequency
  , CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN refund_cents ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS refund_amount_rate
  , CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(1), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS cancel_rate
  , CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS refund_order_rate
  , CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents - paid_cents ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS discount_rate
  , CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS items_per_order
FROM "data"."main"."orders" orders_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
answer: 2026年8月（统计区间2026-08-01至2026-09-01）青禾客户整体汇总结果：有效订单均额为37.15元/单；购买会员人均消费为66.87元/账户；购买频次为1.80单/账户；退款金额占比为15.75%；取消率为6.25%；退款订单率为13.33%；优惠率为4.19%；单均商品件数为1.22件/单。以上均为该客户当月汇总口径，未按门店等维度拆分；购买会员人数按CRM会员账户计数。各指标分母均非零，结果均已定义。
